common.title: Adoption Delivers
common.line: Public-sector AI adoption produces visible, measurable benefit – waiting lists that fall, decisions that arrive in days rather than months, teaching that demonstrably works – and it is attributed to a European decision rather than to an American product.

common.title: Major Cyber Incident
common.line: A large, largely automated attack lands.

common.title: Robots Leave the Demonstration Floor
common.line: Robots reach commercial deployment – not the demonstration videos, convincing for years now, but machines bought in quantity and put to work in warehouses, food processing, loading docks and the parts of manufacturing that resisted automation because the sequence varied.

common.title: Export Control Escalation
common.line: Chip and model export controls tighten again.

common.title: Knowledge Work Is Boosted, Not Replaced
common.line: The evidence arrives from ordinary offices rather than from laboratories: measured productivity gains in law, accountancy, administration, journalism and consulting, largest among the least experienced, and no matching fall in employment.

common.title: Science Delivers
common.line: A significant research result, with AI doing what used to be the hard part.

notable.title: Catastrophic Biological Incident
notable.line: A global biological outbreak caused by a pathogen designed with AI.
